AI Compass

AI lessons for beginners: short, free, step by step

Fifteen short lessons in plain words. Read one here, then open it in the app to try its mini-lab and check yourself.

🌱 Basics

  1. What is AI?What artificial intelligence really is — and what it isn't.
  2. Machine LearningHow computers learn from examples instead of instructions.
  3. Neural NetworksThe brain-inspired idea behind modern AI, explained simply.
  4. Generative AI & ChatbotsHow chatbots and image generators create brand-new content.
  5. AI in Everyday LifeThe hidden AI you use every day — probably without noticing.
  6. AI Ethics & SafetyBias, deepfakes and privacy — and how to use AI responsibly.

🤿 Deep dive

  1. How Computers SeeHow a picture turns into numbers, and how a network finds edges, shapes and objects in them.
  2. Learning by Trial and ErrorHow an AI learns from rewards, the way you learn a new game: try, fail, try again.
  3. How Chatbots WriteTokens, probabilities and attention: what really happens when a chatbot writes an answer.
  4. Creative AIHow AI makes pictures, music and stories, how a picture appears out of noise, and the questions it raises.
  5. Can You Trust AI?How AI gets things wrong, how it is tested, how to protect your data, and the rules that are appearing for AI.
  6. Your AI ToolkitHow to ask AI good questions, check its answers, learn honestly with it, and keep growing your skills.

🌍 AI in your world

  1. Data: The Fuel of AIWhere the examples that AI learns from come from, how they go wrong, and why a model is always tested on examples it has never seen.
  2. How Apps Choose for YouHow video, music and shopping apps decide what to show you next, which signals they read, and how to stay in charge of your feed.
  3. Plan Your Own AI ProjectFrom an idea to a working model: choosing a problem, collecting data, testing honestly and thinking about the people it affects.
